subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — ACME MAP & Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACME MAP — post-call recap and proposed MAP (draft attached)

Thanks again for taking the time today, Alex — good conversation. Quick recap from our end and a proposed mutual action plan (attached) so we have alignment on stakeholders, milestones, and decision gates.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Inconsistent latency for real-time recommendations during peak (up to ~800–1200ms) which impacts conversion.
- Cost per inference is spiking on current infra due to inefficient batching and fragmented model variants.
- Security/compliance constraints around tenant isolation and audit logs for PII.

Goals you outlined:
- Reduce median tail latency to <200ms for the primary recommender path.
- Bring per-1M-token serving cost down by ~30% via batching + quantization profiles.
- Achieve audit log and KMS integration for the initial pilot (POC) before procurement approval.

Proposed MAP (high level — see attached spreadsheet for dates/owners):
1) Week of Mar 15 — POC kickoff: define success metrics, access & data sample ingestion (owner: ACME: Alex; Redwood: Marissa).
2) Mar 22–Apr 9 — POC execution: baseline metrics, apply batching and KV-cache tuning, run quality evals.
3) Apr 12 — POC review: results, go/no-go recommendation (stakeholders: Alex, Priya, Marissa, Nikhil).
4) Apr 19–30 — Procurement & SOW negotiation; target Dedicated capacity start in May.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Alex: confirm procurement contact and ideal decision date (we heard end of April).
- Priya: can you confirm sample dataset availability and whether we should use masked PII?
- Nikhil/Sean: I'll work with you to finalize the POC runbook and infra templates.

Attachment: ACME_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an updated MAP based on replies and will add the DocuSign link for the SOW once we agree on dates.

—
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: ACME MAP — post-call recap and proposed MAP (draft attached)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Confirming a few items from our side: 

1) Procurement contact: Priya Shah (cc'd) will own procurement and SOW review. Priya prefers to have the initial SOW by Apr 5 to circulate internally.
2) Decision deadline: leadership comp will review pilot results the week of Apr 12 with a target decision by Apr 16 (we can push to Apr 19 if needed).
3) Data & security: we can provide a masked sample dataset by Mar 18; full review of logging/KMS will need a short questionnaire — Priya, we'll coordinate with you on timing.

One request: can the POC include an A/B slot so we can validate quality impact for recommendation relevance? If so, let's include the evaluation criteria in the MAP.

On dates: Mar 15 kickoff works; move POC window to Mar 22–Apr 10 to give us a day buffer for internal reviews.

Happy to sync on a quick 20-min call tomorrow if that helps.

—Alex
Director, ML Engineering | Acme Corp
